Deploy Gate Terms of Service

Last updated: February 2025

Acceptance of Terms

By installing and using the HAP Deploy Gate GitHub App, you agree to these terms of service.

Service Description

HAP Deploy Gate is a merge-blocking check for GitHub Pull Requests. It enables required reviewers to create cryptographic attestations before code can be merged. The service:

  • Receives webhook events from GitHub when PRs are created or updated
  • Stores attestation data temporarily (1-hour TTL)
  • Updates GitHub check statuses based on attestation state

Free Service
